newsitem.title: UK: UK cable industry apppoints digital supplier.
newsitem.headline: UK cable industry apppoints digital supplier.

text.p: Britain's three largest cable operators, Telewest Communications Plc, Bell Cablemedia Plc and NYNEX CableComms Group said it had selected an initial supplier of digital equipment.
NextLevel Broadband Networks Group of General Instrument Corp will supply transmission equipment and set top boxes for viewers to receive digital services in cable homes.
The cable set-top box is expected to deliver a wide range of interactive products in the market including video-on-demand, Internet and on-line information and transaction services.
Stephen Davidson chief executive of Telewest said "this is a major step towards the delivery of an exciting range of services to our customers that will revolutionise UK television."
The three cable companies also expect to adopt a digital terrestrial and digital satellite compatible applications programming interface.
